g.text: AI exposure and demographic employment paths in Korea
Fixed upper/lower employment-weighted quintiles of 2025 AI exposure. Annual mean of April and October employment.
Grey marks 2020–2022; dashed line marks 2023. These are employment stocks, not employment rates or AI-caused job changes.
